name: native-tools-enforcer
description: Enforces use of Claude Code native tools / native-build bfs & ugrep instead of bash equivalents (cat, find, grep, sed, echo). Adapts messages to the detected build: new mode (macOS/Linux native with bfs/ugrep), classic mode (Windows, or older builds with Glob/Grep tools), or pass-through when neither toolchain is available.
